name: Nagant M1895
description: Double-action seven-shot revolver. Light round, quick trigger.

name: Nagant M1895 Officer
description: Lightened Nagant with a crisp trigger: fires as fast as you can pull.

name: Caldwell Conversion
description: Single-action six-shooter converted to cartridges. Heavier round than the Nagant.

name: Caldwell Conversion Uppercut
description: Conversion chambered for rifle rounds. Kicks hard, carries far.

name: Caldwell Pax
description: Big single-action revolver in medium calibre. The frontier peacemaker.

name: Scottfield Model 3
description: Break-action revolver: reloading is a free action once per exchange.

weapon.notes: Reload is a free action (once per exchange)

name: Bornheim No. 3
description: Semi-automatic pistol. Weak round, lots of them, quickly.

name: Dolch 96
description: Ten-round semi-automatic with a stripper clip. Rare, precise, expensive.

name: LeMat Mark II
description: Nine-shot revolver with a shotgun barrel under the cylinder.

weapon.notes: Once per load, fire the shotgun barrel instead: Close 3, cone

name: Sparks Pistol
description: A Sparks action cut down to a pistol. One rifle round in the palm of your hand.

name: Romero 77 Handcannon
description: Sawn-off Romero. Fits in a holster, fills a doorway with lead.

name: Caldwell Rival 78 Handcannon
description: Sawn-off double barrel. Two shells, no range.

name: Specter 1882 Compact
description: Cut-down pump shotgun. Three shells.

name: Quad Derringer
description: Four tiny barrels, a tool rather than a weapon. For the last word.

weapon.notes: Tool: does not use a weapon slot

name: Flare Pistol
description: Fires a burning flare: sets whatever it hits alight and lights up the zone.

weapon.notes: Tool: does not use a weapon slot. The zone gets the aspect Lit Up

name: Hand Crossbow
description: Silent, slow, and its bolts can be poisoned.

weapon.notes: Tool: does not use a weapon slot. Silent: no Notice roll to hear it

name: Winfield M1873
description: Lever-action rifle. Light round, fifteen of them.

name: Winfield M1873C
description: Carbine Winfield: shorter, eight rounds, fits a medium slot.

name: Winfield 1876 Centennial
description: Lever-action in medium calibre. The Winfield that hits.

name: Springfield 1866
description: Trapdoor single-shot carbine. Simple, reliable, medium calibre.

name: Vetterli 71 Karabiner
description: Bolt-action carbine, six rounds, medium calibre. Does everything well enough.

name: Mosin-Nagant M1891
description: Bolt-action rifle, five long rounds. Deadly at range.

name: Lebel 1886
description: Tube-fed bolt-action, eight long rounds. Slow to top up.

name: Krag 1896
description: Smooth bolt-action, side-loading magazine. Reloads fast.

weapon.notes: Reload is a free action (once per exchange)

name: Martini-Henry IC1
description: Falling-block single shot. A heavy round, a slow reload.

name: Sparks LRR
description: Single-shot long-range rifle. One round, one chance, a lot of noise.

name: Mosin-Nagant Avtomat
description: Semi-automatic Mosin, fifteen rounds. Jams if you look at it wrong.

name: Nitro Express
description: Elephant gun. Two rounds that stop anything that walks, bosses included.

weapon.notes: Ignores 1 point of armour

name: Drilling
description: Two shotgun barrels over a rifle barrel.

weapon.notes: Also carries 2 shotgun shells: Close 4, cone; swap barrels as a free action

name: Bomb Lance
description: Whaling harpoon launcher. Fires one explosive lance, then it is a spear.

weapon.notes: Melee with Fight: Close 3

name: Hunting Bow
description: Silent and quick to draw. Arrows can be recovered.

weapon.notes: Silent. Arrows are recovered after the fight (Bolt Seer: always)

name: Crossbow
description: Silent, slow, heavy bolts. Explosive and poison bolts exist.

weapon.notes: Silent. Bolts are recovered after the fight (Bolt Seer: always)

name: Romero 77
description: Single-barrel shotgun. Its spread hits everyone in front of the shooter (cone).

name: Caldwell Rival 78
description: Double-barrel shotgun. Both barrels in one exchange if you like.

name: Specter 1882
description: Pump-action shotgun, five shells.

name: Terminus
description: Lever-action shotgun, six shells. Fast and loud.

name: Crown & King
description: Semi-automatic shotgun. Five shells as fast as you can pull.

name: Slate
description: Heavy double-barrel with tight choke. Reaches further than other shotguns.

name: Knife
description: Short blade. Quiet and quick.

name: Dusters
description: Brass knuckles. Blunt, fast, silent.

weapon.notes: Blunt (Hornskin applies; never ignites an Immolator)

name: Heavy Knife
description: A big blade with a heavy spine.

name: Combat Axe
description: Hatchet with a spike on the back.

weapon.notes: Can be thrown with Tomahawk

name: Machete
description: Long cane blade. Wide arcs.

name: Cavalry Saber
description: Curved steel. Reach and speed.

weapon.notes: +1 to Fight defence against melee

name: Railroad Hammer
description: A sledge found by the tracks. Slow, heavy, blunt.

weapon.notes: Blunt (Hornskin applies). Found in the world, not bought

name: Shovel
description: A tool first, a weapon when it has to be.

weapon.notes: Blunt. Found in the world

name: Throwing Knives
description: Four balanced blades. Silent.

weapon.notes: Silent. Recovered after the fight

name: Throwing Axes
description: Two heavy axes. Loud when they land.

weapon.notes: Recovered after the fight

name: Throwing Spear
description: One long spear. Pins what it hits.

weapon.notes: Recovered after the fight

name: Lantern
description: An oil lantern taken off a hook. Shatters and spreads fire where it lands.

weapon.notes: Found in the world

name: Fusee
description: A road flare. Lights the zone and sets fire to whatever it lands on. Three per pack.

weapon.notes: Tool. Three charges

name: Dynamite Stick
description: A short fuse and a big bang. Destroys light cover in the zone.

name: Dynamite Bundle
description: Three sticks tied together. Takes the walls with it.

name: Big Dynamite Bundle
description: Enough dynamite to drop a barn.

weapon.notes: Heavy: Throw difficulty +1

name: Waxed Dynamite Stick
description: Waterproof fuse: can be cooked (Sapper) and lit in the rain.

weapon.notes: Burns in water. Cooking the fuse never fails

name: Frag Bomb
description: Shrapnel tears through everyone in the zone.

name: Waxed Frag Bomb
description: A frag bomb with a waterproof fuse.

weapon.notes: Burns in water. Cooking the fuse never fails

name: Sticky Bomb
description: Thrown at a person (Throw vs Athletics). Whoever it sticks to gets no blast defence.

name: Concertina Bomb
description: Scatters razor wire across the zone.

name: Fire Bomb
description: An incendiary flask. Fire kills ordinary monsters outright; hunters catch fire.

name: Liquid Fire Bomb
description: Burning oil that spreads: the fire covers a wider zone and lasts longer.

name: Hellfire Bomb
description: A heavy incendiary charge. Fire kills ordinary monsters outright; hunters catch fire.

name: Hive Bomb
description: A nest of hive insects. No blast: the swarm poisons whoever is in the zone and stays there.

explosive.zoneAspect: Hive Swarm (−1 to all rolls until you leave)

name: Poison Bomb
description: A cloud of poison gas. No damage, but it lingers.

explosive.zoneAspect: Poison Cloud (Poisoned each exchange you stay)

name: Choke Bomb
description: Thick choking smoke: −2 to all rolls in the zone, no Dark Sight. Puts out fires.

explosive.zoneAspect: Choking Smoke (−2 to all rolls, no Dark Sight)

weapon.notes: Extinguishes Burning Ground and Burning hunters in the zone

name: Flash Bomb
description: A blinding burst. No damage; everyone in the zone is Blinded.

name: Chaos Bomb
description: A string of firecrackers and gunshot sounds. Everyone hears a gunfight that isn't there.

explosive.zoneAspect: Gunfire Over There (Notice to tell it from a real fight)

weapon.notes: No damage: used to draw monsters and hunters

name: First Aid Kit
description: Bandages, needle and thread. Three uses per mission.

effect.text: Clears 2 Health boxes and stops the bleeding. Takes your action (Physician: free once per exchange; Doctor: 4 boxes).

name: Vitality Shot
description: A syringe of something that works. Instant.

effect.text: Clears 2 Health boxes at once. Free action.

name: Weak Vitality Shot
description: Half a dose. Better than nothing.

name: Regeneration Shot
description: Knits burned flesh back together. Restores a lost Health chunk over the scene.

effect.text: Restores 1 Burned chunk and clears 1 Health box, then 1 more box at the end of each of the next 3 exchanges (not while Poisoned).

name: Antidote Shot
description: Neutralises poison and keeps it out for a while.

effect.text: Cures Poisoned. Immune to Poisoned until the end of the scene (Hive swarms, poison clouds, Spider spit).

name: Weak Antidote Shot
description: Cures the poison, nothing more.

name: Stamina Shot
description: Adrenaline and coca. You stop feeling your legs.

effect.text: Until the end of the scene: sprinting is a free action (move twice and still act), +1 to Athletics overcome rolls.

name: Ammo Box
description: A crate of common calibres. Refills spare rounds.

effect.text: Spare rounds of every firearm you carry are refilled (Decoy Supply: decoys too).

name: Special Ammo Box
description: Hand-loaded rounds: incendiary, poison, FMJ, high velocity or dumdum.

effect.text: Refills spare rounds and lets you switch one weapon's ammo type (weapon settings).

name: Spyglass
description: Brass telescope. Reads the far bank.

effect.text: +2 to Notice to spot hunters or monsters at Long and Extreme range.

name: Decoys
description: Stones, bottles and bits of tin. Thrown to make noise somewhere else.

effect.text: Throw into a zone up to two zones away: the zone gets the aspect Noise Over There (free invoke). Monsters and hunters without Notice turn toward it.

name: Decoy Fuses
description: Sparkling fuses that sound like lit dynamite.

effect.text: Throw into a zone: everyone there must pass Will vs Fair (+2) or leave the zone this exchange.

name: Concertina Trap
description: A coil of razor wire that springs open when stepped on.

effect.text: Place in your zone (Crafts, free action; Poacher: silent). The first to enter without Notice vs Fair (+2) takes 2 damage and Bleeding; the zone gets Razor Wire.

name: Poison Trap
description: A hive-insect jar rigged to shatter.

effect.text: Place in your zone (Crafts, free action; Poacher: silent). The first to enter without Notice vs Fair (+2) is Poisoned; the zone gets Poison Cloud.

name: Alert Trip Mine
description: A tripwire that fires a flare and a shriek.

effect.text: Place in a zone exit (Crafts, free action). When triggered: everyone within three zones hears it, the zone is Lit Up.

name: Bear Trap
description: Iron jaws. Loud, slow, cruel.

effect.text: Place in your zone (Crafts, free action). The first to enter without Notice vs Good (+3) takes 3 damage, Bleeding, and is Pinned until an Athletics overcome at Fair (+2).

name: Choke Beetle
description: A beetle you guide by Dark Sight. Bursts into choking smoke on command.

effect.text: Placed as a token up to 40 m away, with its own sight (8 m) through the fog of war. Move it to guide it (Lore overcome vs Fair +2 past watchful hunters). Lives 3 exchanges. Release: choking smoke 5 m around it (Blinded, Choking Smoke, fires go out).

name: Stalker Beetle
description: A beetle you guide by Dark Sight. Shows you what it sees.

effect.text: Placed as a token up to 40 m away, with its own sight (15 m) through the fog of war: find the rival hunters. Move it to guide it (Lore overcome vs Fair +2 past watchful hunters). Lives 3 exchanges. Burst: every targeted hunter it can see is Spotted (eye icon, free invoke).
